from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as named in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
